newsitem.title: JAPAN: Two employees sue Sumitomo Bank U.S. unit--Kyodo.
newsitem.headline: Two employees sue Sumitomo Bank U.S. unit--Kyodo.

text.p: Two loan examiners have filed suit against a Sumitomo Bank Ltd unit in California for compensation for losses they say they suffered after refusing to go along with the bank's senior managers in extending loans, Kyodo news agency reported on Tuesday.
The amount of damages sought was not known, it said.
A Sumitomo Bank spokeswoman in Tokyo told Reuters that Sumitomo Bank of California, which is based in San Francisco, had dismissed the claims as groundless.
Sumitomo Bank shares stumbled in late Tuesday afternoon trade because of media reports about the suit.
The shares closed down 80 yen at 1,770 on turnover of about five million shares, making Sumitomo Bank the seventh-most heavily traded issue on the first section of the Tokyo bourse.
"Sumitomo shares weakened in the afternoon session," a trader at a foreign brokerage said. "It seems that the report has some investors worried."
